How this was made
An original world informed by Adam Robinson-Yu's discussion of A Short Hike: cohesive flat shading, no anti-aliasing, subtle outlines, adjustable pixels, and rewarding detours.
Here: procedural 3D geometry, an orthographic follow camera, low-resolution render target, nearest upscaling, depth-aware outlines, and a small color-quantization pass. These are our implementations, not claims about the game's exact pipeline.

WELCOME, WANDERER
There's no hurry here.
Follow the pale trail uphill. Talk to Mina at the landing, find three skyglass pieces, and bring their light to the hilltop lantern.
Use WASD or arrow keys to walk. Space hops. E talks or interacts. Q/R rotate your view. Drag the scene to orbit and scroll to zoom.
Click or tap the ground to walk there. On touch screens, use the direction pad and action buttons.
Open Render lab to compare pixel sizes and effects. Your little errand is saved only in this browser.
